tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen yig nyung ngu sbyin sreg dang bcas pa khro rgyal dgongs rgyan bzhugs so// 'jigs byed zhi ba'i sbyin sreg ni/ sa chog byas par thig chen brgyad/ /btab la thab khung ngag 'don bzhin/ /de nang pad+ma 'dab brgyad lter/ /rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga gdengs/ /gnas khang rnying pa phal cher la mi dgos/ shar lho'i mtshams su ting lo bzhag /kha sbyor bud shing zlum por ni/ /mtho gang brtsigs la 'jig rten nub/ /rang stan drung du me yol rgyab/ /lcog steng rdor dril bar dgang blugs/ /kha sbyor nang mchod 'thor snod bshams/ /rang gi g.yas nas rim pa bzhin/ /yam shing mar til zas mchog dang / /'bras dang so ba nas sran ma/ /gro dur ku sha kha gso bcas/ /g.yon nas chu gnyis nyer mchod dang / zlum gtor lnga bshams rgyas pa bskyed na bskang gtor kyang bshams/ gzhan yang ni/ /gos zung ku sha'i chun po brgyad/ /sha sna mo lha'i gtor ma sogs/ /'og du gang dgos 'dus byas la/ /rdzas dang yo byad thams cad la/ /hūm̐ zhes nang mchod bsang gtor bya/ /phyi dro khrus khang gtsang sbrar ldan/ /rgyan gos dkar zhing zhi sems kyis/ /shar lta skyil krung ngam tsog bus 'khod/ /gnas yo byin rlabs nas bdag bskyed bsdu ba'i bar bya/ rdzas dang yo byad rnams la rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod 'thor tshul dang / ya man+ta ka dang / swa bhā was bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod rdzas dang / bsreg rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ so so'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐ gi bar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swāhās yam shing / oṃ shrī swāhās mar/ oṃ dz+riṃ swāhas 'bru/ oṃ swa swāhās rdzas rnams bkru/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swāhās rdzas rnams sbyangs/

'di rnams kyi phyag rgya mchod yon gyi phyag rgya kho na yin par gdan bzhi las gsungs/ thab la rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod 'thor tshul dang / ya man+ta ka dang / swa bhā was bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po rgyar khru gang / zab tu khru phyed/ kha khyer dang mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng bas mtshan pa/ phyi rol stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes brgyan pa nang lha rdzas kyi bud shing gis gang bar gyur/ rgyun bzhag gi me'am shing 'o ma can gtsubs pa las byung ba'i mes spor lde sbar la thal mo'i bar du bzung nas thab la g.yas bskor lan gsum dang bstun oṃ ya man+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa ces dang / oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ zhes thab nang gi ting lo sbar la 'jag ma sogs kyi me kha gsos/ dgang blugs kha sbyar gyi mar khu thab la g.yas skor du lan gsum blugs pa dang bstun/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ zhes brjod/ rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod me la 'thor tshul dang / ya man+ta ka dang / swā bha was me bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang / raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du raṃ las bgrang phreng raṃ gyis mtshan pa las/ me lha dkar po ra skyes la zhon pa/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis na bgrang phreng dang mchog sbyin/ g.yon gnyis na dbyug gu rtse gsum pa dang / ghun+de 'dzin pa/ gsus khyim che ba/ ral pa'i thor gtsug dang / sma ra dang ag tshom can tshangs skud 'chang ba/ drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying khar hūm̐/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas shar lho nas me lha 'khor bcas oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje g.yab dril bu gsil gdangs yod med gang rung gis/ oṃ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /bsreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'di nyid du ni gshegs su gsol/ /gzi brjid chen po me yi lha/

/'dod pa thams cad sgrub pa po/ /thugs rjes sems can don mdzad pa/ /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /zhes lan gsum dang / rdor dril bzhag la lag gnyis skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya las mthe bong gnyis so so'i gung mo'i rtsa bar bzhag mdzub mo gnyis gung mo gnyis kyi rgyab la sbyar ba rna ba g.yas g.yon gyi drung du g.yab cing / oṃ ag+na ye ma hā te dzaḥ sarba karma pra sā dha kaḥ kā ru ṇ+ya kṛ ta sa tā ar+than/ armin+san+ni hi to bha wa/ zhes brjod me yol yod pas phyir 'brang gi bgegs bskrad ma dgos/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra/ ar+ghṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ zhes so so'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ ag+na ye sa pā ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes mtheb srin gyis nang mchod phul/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha nas/ ghaṇ+ḍe ho bar so so'i phyag rgya bcas dam tshig pa la dgug gzhug bcing mnyes par bya/ slar yang rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañca ku la sa pā ri wā ra/ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ sogs nas/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐ gi bar gong bzhin/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po la/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyis/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣiñca su ra ta satwaṃ a haṃ/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ ku sha'i chun po brgyad la rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod 'thor tshul dang / ya man+ta ka dang / swa bhā wās bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa thab kyi 'bags pa dang ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/

thal mo'i bar du bzung la gdangs yod med gang rung gis/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de/ /tshangs pa yi yang dag byed yin/ /de yis bdag la gegs med cing zhi bar mdzod/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa aḥ zhes dang grogs kyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du rtse mo g.yas skor du bkram/ g.yas g.yon khu tshur las mdzub mo dang mthe bong brkyangs pa byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya 'cha' ba'i tshul gyis dgang blugs bzung la/ me lha'i zhal la raṃ dang / dgang blugs kyi kha la oṃ ā hūm̐ gis mtshan pa zhes dang / oṃ ag+na ye swāhā/ bdun gyi mar phul mthar/ dgang blugs kha sbyar thab la g.yas bskor dang / oṃ ag+na ye ā dī pyā dī pya/ ā bi ṣa/ ā bi ṣa/ ma hā/ shrī ye/ ha bya ka bya/ ba ha nā ya/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nad gdon bar chad thams cad dang / sngags lhag chad kyi nyes pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ de 'dra lan gsum ste mar dgang blugs nyer gcig gis byon skyems phul/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du shap+ta'i bar la rigs 'gre/ dril gsil rol chen dharma ra ṇi bya/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ dril gsil gdangs yod med gang rung gis/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ḍā ki'i dbang bskur zhing / /shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsregs/ /'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /'phags pa rin po che dang / dkon mchog lhun grub kyi sbyin sreg gi gzhung nas me bkra brtag pa ma gsungs kyang / spyi 'gre yin pas sor bsdus pa brtag na/ zhi la dkar dang rgyas la ser/ /dbang la dmar dang drag la nag /ces dang mdog dkar zhing snum pa sgra cung zad dang bcas pa du ba chung ba ni zhi ba'i las la dge'o/

/du ba che zhing me stag 'phro ba ni ngan pas hūm̐ zhes brjod cing rdo rje gsor la bgegs zhi bar bya'o/ /de nas zhu rdzas zhal/ gong rdzas phyag yam shing me/ ku sha gtsug tor la phul bar bsams la/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣa ya swāhā gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ ag+na ye swāhā/ bdun gyis phul mthar/ oṃ ag+na ye bdag dang sems can sogs spel tshig gong bzhin/ de bzhin du mar nas bzung / ku sha'i bar la'ang rdzas sngags so so lan gsum re sngon 'gro'i rdzas so sor byin gyis brlabs la oṃ ag+na ye swāhā/ 'ga' zhig gi 'bul ba yin pas/ de'i rim pa ni/ oṃ ag+na ye swāhās mar/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ya swāhās til/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swāhās zas mchog oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swāhās 'bras/ oṃ badz+ra bi dz+wa ya swāhās so ba/ oṃ ma hā be gā ya swāhās nas/ oṃ ma hā ba la ya swāhās sran ma/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rā ya swāhā gro/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swāhās dur ba/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ya swāhās ku sha rnams lan bdun re phul mthar/ spel tshig gong bzhin sbyar/ mchod bstod gong bzhin mar dgang blugs gang thab tu 'bul ba dang bstun/ oṃ ag+na ye dz+wa la raṃ/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/ zhes brjod 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa'o/ /'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad par sngon gyi smon lam gyi mthus/ zhes sogs nas/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum brjod pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ dur khrod thod mkhar bcas bskyed kyang 'gal ba med mod/ 'on kyang 'phags pa rin po che'i sbyin sreg gi gzhung du srung 'khor gyi nang lha bskyed pa las ma gsungs pas/ de'i ngag 'don ni bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i steng du zhes sogs nas/ ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥbar sgrub thabs bzhin la bdag mdun gyi tshig mi 'dra ba'i khyad gtor bsngo'i lha bskyed chog bzhin sbyar/

sems dpa' sum brtsegs mi dgos/ bla ma mi bskyod pa rigs bdag gi tshul du bzhugs shing / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal dang sku las mdangs dang 'od zer dkar po 'phro zhing thugs ka nas spros pa'i pho nya zhi ma khro dkar po dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa bdud rtsi'i gang ba'i bum thod sogs zhi ba'i phyag mtshan sna tshogs 'dzin pa rnams kyis bdag dang sems can la sogs spel tshig bzhin la/ nyes pa thams cad zhi ba'i las mdzad par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam/ oṃ ya man+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan bdun gyis byon skyems phul mthar/ a dī pyā dī pya sogs spel tshig bcas gong bzhin mar dgang blugs nyi shu rtsa gcig phul/ dkon mchog lhun grub kyi sbyin bsreg gi gzhung na mtshams 'dir mchod bstod gtor ma rnams dang / 'bul tshan rdzogs nas mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig gsung 'dug kyang 'di gnyis go brjes na 'gal ba med cing lag len bde bas/ de'i tshul ni rdo rje'i rtses mchod pa rnams la nang mchod 'thor tshul dang / ya man+ta ka dang / swa bhā was bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la zhes sogs gnas yo byin rlabs bzhin la/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur zhes dang / oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā gu ru badz+ra bhai ra wa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du shap+ta'i bar la rigs 'gre/ dharma ra ṇi dril gsil rol chen/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā gu ru badz+ra bhai ra wa sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ nang mchod hrīḥṣ+ṭiḥphul kyang chog 'di bzhin byas kyang 'gal ba med/ dril gsil rol chen bcas/ gzugs sgra la sogs nas/ chags par mdzod bar gyis yid mchod/ dur khrod brgyad kyi nas/ dud kha mun chen khyod la bstod/ /bar bya/ rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod bsreg rdzas rnams la 'thor tshul byas la/

ya man+ta ka dang / swa bhā was bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i bsreg rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swāhā nas/ ku ru ku ru swāhā bar gong bzhin byin gyis brlabs/ yang sha sna bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las kaṃ las sogs nas/ ha ho hrīḥbar gyis nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs/ rdzas rnams oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣa la sogs pa so so'i sngags lan gsum gsum gyis sngon du byin gyis brlabs/ dngos gzhi hrīḥṣ+ṭīḥkho nas bcu gcig re phul mthar spel tshig sbyar/ ku sha rdzogs na/ sha sna tshogs 'bul skabs/ oṃ ka la rū pa sarba satwa dwa ma ka ma hā bhu ta pa ti i daṃ bhu dza gṛh+ṇa pa ya/ gṛh+ṇa pa ya/ zhes bcu gcig phul mthar/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe 'khor ba sogs spel tshig sbyar/ bcu cha'i sbyin sreg dngos la grangs bsag tshul ni/ pang par til dang gsag snod bzhag g.yas kyi mtheb srin gyis til la grangs gsog tshul dang / g.yon gyi phreng ba bgrang la grangs bzung / de yang nyin bzhi la cho ga drug byas nas tshugs nyin hrīḥṣ+ṭīḥstong phrag re song mtshams/ thog mar ci yang mi brjod pa bsags til thab nang du 'bul/ de nas rdzas so so gong bzhin 'bul/ tshan bcu gcig re byas pa tshar bcu/ nyin bar pa gnyis kyi pra chog dgong chog la hrīḥṣ+ṭiḥstong kha sbyor song mtshams 'bul tshan bya/ grol nyin tshugs chog sor bzhag byas pas 'bum phrag gcig lhag tsam 'gro/ gong ltar 'bul tshan rnams rdzogs mthar gang ba'i sbyin sreg gshegs skyems 'bul lugs gong gi byon skyems bzhin no/ /de nas mchod pa rnams kha gsos bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs gong bzhin byas la/ pang par khu tshur g.yon 'og dang / g.yas steng du brtsegs pa kha sbyar/ gdangs yod med gang rung gis/

dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgongs par mdzod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā gu ru sogs gong bzhin la pad skor mchod pa so so'i phyag rgya mthar se gol phyir gtogs nang gtogs/ de bzhin du/ lha rdzas dam pa'i zhabs bsil 'di/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i me tog 'di/ /zhes sogs rol mo'i bar la 'don pa bsgyur/ mthar dharma ra ṇi dril gsil rol chen/ gos zung bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gos srab pa 'jam pa yang ba zung du sbyar ba dang ldan par gyur/ khu tshur gyis bzung la/ gdangs yod med gang rung gis/ srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos/ /mi phyed rdo rje'i sku la gsol/ /mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na/ /bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā gu ru badz+ra bhai ra wa sa pa ri wa ra oṃ badz+ra wa pra s+ya āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes thog mar rang gi g.yon la mtho bar 'phyar te stod g.yogs 'bul tshul dang / de nas g.yas la dma' bar byas te smad g.yogs 'bul tshul bya/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes bdud rtsi byin rlabs dran tsam dang / yang oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi nas blangs la/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed༞ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma༞ la li ta badz+ra༞ a mo gha badz+ra༞ ye shes 'byung gnas sbas pa༞ pad+ma badz+ra༞ dī paṃ ka ra༞ rwa rdo rje grags༞ rwa chos rab༞ rwa ye shes seng ge༞ rwa 'bum seng༞ klog skya dbang phyug grags༞ ldong ston shes rab dpal༞ 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa༞

zhang dkon mchog dpal༞ na bza' brag phug pa༞ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan༞ mkhan chen byang chub dpal bzang po༞ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan༞ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po༞ gu ge paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan༞ glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub༞ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams༞ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub༞ yongs 'dzin dkon mchog dpal ldan༞ shar chen kun dga' bkra shis༞ shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas༞ mkhan chen lhun grub dpal ldan༞ chos rje bstan 'dzin lhun grub༞ bdag gi drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa dpal thar rtse ba chen po 'jam mgon bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa nam mkha' bsam 'grub kun dga' mtshan dpe'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ kho bos 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad skor gyi dbang brgyud gcig 'di yin/ gcig 'phrin las tsha zer bzhin yin zhing / gzhan yang nang gses kyi dbye ba mang ngo / /gzhan yang dbang bskur rgyud bshad man ngag nos chos kyi 'brel pa thob pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ya ma rā dza sogs/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭiḥsogs/ oṃ ya man+ta ka sogs/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa'i rgyud de/ rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lce rtse smin mtshams spyi gtsug rnams su thig le byas la oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes lus dkyil lha mchod dang / gtor ma bar phud kyis bran/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya ma hā kā li de wī ye dharma pā la tsa turmu kha sa pa ri wā ra rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral gdong bzhi pa sogs/ dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ kā la ru pa sa pa ri wā ra 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

gzhan yang chos 'khor bsrung zhing bstan pa skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phyogs skyong bcu/ lha chen brgyad/ klu chen brgyad/ gza' chen dgu/ rgyu skaranyi shu rtsa brgyad/ 'jigs byed chen po dgu/ rgyal po chen po sde bzhi la sogs pa 'jig rten skyong ba rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang gnod sbyin/ srin po/ 'byung po/ yi dwags/ sha za/ smyo byed/ brjed byed/ ma mo/ zhing skyong / pho nya/ 'phrog ma/ grub pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang bod khams skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa dang / gnas bdag gzhi bdag yul bdag grong bdag dkor bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga/ skyes gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad tshim zhing zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud gang nas myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta badz+ra swa bhā wā at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes rang gis myangs/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pa na/ /oṃ badz+ra lā s+ye hūm̐/ rdo rje rin chen bla na med/ /oṃ badz+ra mā le trāṃ/ rdo rje chos kyi glu blangs pa/ /oṃ badz+ra gī ti hrīḥ rdo rje las kun byed par gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra nirti āḥ oṃ badz+ra sa twa su saṃ gra haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐/ badz+ra rat+na ma nu tra ta raṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe trāṃ/ badz+ra dharma ga yā nai/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke hrīḥ badz+ra karma ka reta bhā we/ oṃ badz+ra ghan+dhe āḥ de dag gi tshe tshig rkang dang po rnams la dku g.yon du khu tshur kha sbyar brtsegs/ lā s+ye sogs bzhi la rim bzhin/ dku g.yas g.yon du khu tshur kha gyen bstan/ smin ma g.yas g.yon gnyis kyi thad nas kha phyir lta/ khu tshur gnyis kha nas 'byin tshul/

rdor thal spyi bor bskor ba'i phyag rgya dang / dhū pe sogs bzhi la so so'i phyag rgya bcas la mthar se gol gtogs/ dril gsil rol chen/ gzugs sgra sogs yid mchod/ spro na a mo ghas mdzad pa'i bstod pa dang / rwa lo'i dkyil chog nas 'byung ba'i gtso bstod gang rigs bya zhing / bsdu na dur khrod rgyan gyi sogs so/ /gtor ma byin brlabs nas 'dod gsol gyi bar/ sgrub thabs bdud 'joms snang ba'i gter mdzod nas 'byung ba bzhin la/ gtor mgron bskyed mi dgos pas byin rlabs tshar 'phral 'bul/ rang re'i gtor bsngo chen mo dang / phyogs skyong las gshin sogs sbrel nas 'bul na/ de'i rnam gzhag kho bos brtsams pa'i drug cu'i gtong deb bzhin no/ /phyogs skyong las gshin las mi 'bul na gong gi bsnyen thabs sor bzhag go /gang na'ang rjes chog ni/ 'dod don zhu ba nas bzung / gshegs gsol bar sgrub thabs kyi mjug bzhin la/ slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol gyi rjes su/ oṃ ya man+ta ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ ya man+ta ka twe no pa/ tiṣ+ṭha dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsit+taṃ shri ya ku ru hū?m̐/ ha ha ha ha ho bha ga wān/ sarba ta thā ga ta ya man+ta ka mā me muñca/ badz+ri bha wā ma ha sa ma ya sa twa aḥ zhes lan gcig dang / mtheb srin gyis se gol gtogs la ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ zhes dang srin lag gis thabs kyi thal ba'i rdul cung zad blangs nas dpral bar bku'o/ /me lha lhag mas mchod pa ni/ mar dgang blugs gang thab tu blugs la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ me lha zhal phyag gi rnam par gyur zhes dang / mchod bstod bsreg rdzas 'bul lugs/ gshegs skyems 'bul lugs rnams gong 'jig rten pa'i me lha'i skabs su bshad pa sor bzhag

slar yang mchod bstod byas la/ gtor ma nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs/ spos kyis bdug oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs pad kor sngon 'gro'i nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya'i mthar se gol gtog pa dang bcas/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba liṃ ta ye swāhā/ lan gsum la sogs pas phul/ rdo rje snying kha dang dril bu sum brdung bya zhing / drang srong chen po 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar bya/ thal mo sbyar la bdag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas/ ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang / sngags ma dag pa dang / cho ga 'khrul pa dang / yo byad dman pa la sogs pa'i nyes pa thams cad bzod par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod la spyan 'dren gyi phyag rgya phyir bskyed cing / swaḥ.ar+thañce wa sa rār+thañce/ pā dhi twaṃ gats+tsha ha bya bhu ka ā ga mi ṣi si ya thā kā l+ye/ sarba sid+dhiṃ ku ru ṣa me/ me lha rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po sogs sgrub thabs kyi mjug bzhin no/ /'di ni bcu cha'i sbyin sreg 'bul ba'i dbang du byas la/ gzhan du ni sreg rdzas rnams brgya rtsa re dus gcig la phul bas 'thus so/ /dngos grub kyi phyir me ma yal bar mi 'gul ba'am/ yang na me phal cher yal tshar nas/ 'phro lus pa rnams 'o chol dri bzang can gyi gshegs su gsol la thal ba ri rtse'am 'bab chur gtor ro/ /zhes dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen yig nyung ngu sbyin sreg dang bcas pa 'di yang sa skya pa kun blos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni bkra shis rgyal mtshan no// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen yig nyung ngu sbyin sreg dang bcas pa/
